description: Manages cron and webhook trigger adapters with lifecycle-aware polling scheduler. Polls trigger adapters and submits dispatches through the supervisor path. Mirrors engine/runtime/scheduler.py and engine/interfaces/scheduler.py.
instructions: TriggerSchedulerService polls all registered TriggerAdapters on a configurable interval.
Each adapter returns a list of pending trigger dispatches (each maps to a TaskSubmission).
Adapter dispatches are submitted through the supervisor path (supervisor.submit() or supervisor.run_submission()).
TriggerSchedulerLoopRunner manages the lifecycle with exponential idle backoff, jitter, max-cycle bounds, and graceful stop-signal shutdown.
WebhookIngressService decodes webhook payloads and routes them to named adapters.
Webhook ingress is exposed via POST /v1/triggers/{name} on the control-plane API.
